title: Webull Expands European Presence with Launch in Italy
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL), a global financial technology company, today announced the launch of its brokerage services in Italy,...
body_markdown:
*Italian investors now have access to Webull's technology-driven platform, offering trading opportunities across U.S. and European markets*


ST. PETERSBURG, Fla.


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Webull Corporation](https://www.webullcorp.com/) (NASDAQ:BULL ), a global financial technology company, today announced the launch of its brokerage services in Italy, further expanding the company's international footprint and bringing its technology-driven investing experience to one of Europe's largest markets.


Italian investors can now trade U.S. and European equities, European ETFs, and U.S. options through Webull's mobile and desktop platforms, which offers competitive commissions, broad market access, and advanced trading tools.


Italy joins Webull's growing European business, Webull EU,[which launched in September 2025](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/webull-launches-in-the-european-union-debuting-retail-investment-platform-in-the-netherlands-302547795.html) with the debut of brokerage services in the Netherlands. Headquartered in Amsterdam, Webull EU serves as the operational base for the company's expansion across Europe, with Italy representing the next step in its regional growth strategy.


"Webull's expansion into Italy reflects our continued commitment to bringing a technology-driven investing experience to more investors around the world," said **Andries van Luijk, Chief Executive Officer of Webull EU** . "Our launch in Italy builds on the foundation we have established in the Netherlands and brings our platform to another important European market. We look forward to serving Italian investors with greater access to U.S. and European markets, alongside the tools and capabilities to support their investing goals."


Webull Securities (Europe) B.V. operates under an investment firm license granted by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM), with authorization to provide services across the European Economic Area under the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II).


The launch in Italy marks another step in Webull's international expansion, further strengthening its presence across Europe and its broader network of markets spanning North America, Asia Pacific and Latin America.


For more information, visit[www.webull.eu/it](https://www.webull.eu/it)


**###**


**About Webull Corporation:**


Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) owns and operates Webull, a leading digital investment platform built on next-generation global infrastructure and AI technologies. Through its global network of licensed brokerages, Webull offers investment services in 18 markets across North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, Africa, and Latin America. Webull serves more than 29 million registered users globally, providing retail and institutional investors with 24/7 access to global financial markets. Users can put investment strategies to work by trading global stocks, ETFs, options, futures, fractional shares, and digital assets through Webull's trading platform, which seamlessly integrates market data and information, its user community, and investor education resources. Learn more at[www.webullcorp.com](http://www.webullcorp.com/) .
